# Journalism Statistics

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on statistical calculations.

## API
- [addClusters](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/addClusters.md): addClusters function
- [addMahalanobisDistance](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/addMahalanobisDistance.md): addMahalanobisDistance function
- [addZScore](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/addZScore.md): addZScore function
- [euclidianDistance](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/euclidianDistance.md): euclidianDistance function
- [generateCirPath](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/generateCirPath.md): generateCirPath function
- [generateGbmPath](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/generateGbmPath.md): generateGbmPath function
- [getCholeskyMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getCholeskyMatrix.md): getCholeskyMatrix function
- [getCirParameters](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getCirParameters.md): getCirParameters function
- [getCorrelatedShocks](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getCorrelatedShocks.md): getCorrelatedShocks function
- [getCorrelationMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getCorrelationMatrix.md): getCorrelationMatrix function
- [getCovarianceMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getCovarianceMatrix.md): getCovarianceMatrix function
- [getGbmParameters](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getGbmParameters.md): getGbmParameters function
- [getMahalanobisDistance](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getMahalanobisDistance.md): getMahalanobisDistance function
- [getSampleSizeMean](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getSampleSizeMean.md): getSampleSizeMean function
- [getSampleSizeProportion](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/getSampleSizeProportion.md): getSampleSizeProportion function
- [invertMatrix](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/invertMatrix.md): invertMatrix function
- [performChiSquaredGoodnessOfFitTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/performChiSquaredGoodnessOfFitTest.md): performChiSquaredGoodnessOfFitTest function
- [performChiSquaredIndependenceTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/performChiSquaredIndependenceTest.md): performChiSquaredIndependenceTest function
- [performPairedTTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/performPairedTTest.md): performPairedTTest function
- [performTTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/performTTest.md): performTTest function
- [performTwoSampleTTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/performTwoSampleTTest.md): performTwoSampleTTest function
- [performZTest](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/performZTest.md): performZTest function
- [stepCir](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/stepCir.md): stepCir function
- [stepGbm](https://nshiab.github.io/journalism-statistics/functions/stepGbm.md): stepGbm function
